title: PDF to Word Converter
meta_title: PDF to Word Converter - Free, No Signup | EasyPDFTools
meta_description: Convert a PDF into an editable Word (.docx) file online. Free, no signup. Best for PDFs with selectable text; files are processed temporarily and not kept.
intro: This tool turns a PDF into an editable Word (.docx) document. It reads the text on each page and rebuilds it as paragraphs, headings, bullet lists and simple tables, so you can edit the content in Microsoft Word, Google Docs or LibreOffice.

It works best on PDFs created from a word processor, where the text can be selected. Pictures, custom fonts, multi-column pages and complex layouts are not reproduced exactly, so expect to tidy the result. If your PDF is a scan or a photo, use the Scan to Word (OCR) tool instead.
steps: Click the upload area or drop your PDF onto it (up to 30 MB).
Press Convert & download.
Open the .docx file in Word and review the headings, lists and tables.

faqs.q: Is the PDF to Word converter free?
faqs.a: Yes. There is no signup and no fee. Each file can be up to 30 MB.

faqs.q: Will the layout and images stay the same?
faqs.a: Not exactly. The text is rebuilt as paragraphs, headings, bullet lists and simple tables. Images, custom fonts and multi-column layouts are not reproduced, so plan to tidy the document in Word.

faqs.q: Can it convert a scanned PDF?
faqs.a: Not with this tool, because a scan holds pictures of text rather than real text. Use Scan to Word (OCR) for scanned pages.

faqs.q: Does it work with Arabic or other right-to-left text?
faqs.a: Right-to-left text is detected and set right-to-left in the Word file. PDFs store Arabic in different ways, so check the result. For scanned Arabic documents, use the OCR tool and choose Arabic.

faqs.q: Are my files kept?
faqs.a: Your file is processed temporarily on our server to create the Word document. It is not kept or shared.

title: PDF to Excel Converter
meta_title: PDF to Excel Converter (.xlsx) - Free, No Signup | EasyPDFTools
meta_description: Turn the text and tables in a PDF into an Excel (.xlsx) spreadsheet. Free and no signup. Works on PDFs with selectable text; check the results.
intro: This tool reads the text on every page of a PDF and splits each line into spreadsheet cells wherever it finds a wide gap between columns. The result is an Excel (.xlsx) file with one worksheet called Extracted, with a Page label above the content of each page.

Numbers such as 1,234.50 are saved as real numbers so you can calculate with them, while long IDs and values with leading zeros stay as text. Results depend on how the PDF was made, so always compare the totals with the original.
steps: Upload a PDF that contains selectable text (up to 30 MB).
Press Convert & download.
Open the .xlsx file, check the column alignment and adjust where needed.

faqs.q: How accurate is the table extraction?
faqs.a: Clean tables with clear spacing between columns usually convert well. Complex layouts, merged cells and tables without clear gaps may need manual fixing in Excel.

faqs.q: Will every page get its own sheet?
faqs.a: No. All pages go into a single worksheet, and each page starts with a label such as Page 1.

faqs.q: Does it work on scanned PDFs?
faqs.a: No. A scan holds pictures of text. The Scan to Word (OCR) tool can read scanned pages into a Word document, which you can then copy into Excel.

faqs.q: Are formulas created?
faqs.a: No. The file contains values only, and numbers are stored as numbers where possible.

title: Compress PDF

meta_description: Reduce the size of a PDF by recompressing its images. Choose Light, Balanced or Maximum. Free and no signup; results depend on the file.
intro: This tool makes a PDF smaller by recompressing the images inside it, scaling down very large ones, and compressing the internal data of each page. You can choose Light, Balanced or Maximum compression, and after processing it shows how much space was saved.

PDFs full of photos or scans shrink the most. A PDF that is mostly text, or that was already optimised, may not get much smaller. If the result would not be smaller, you receive the original file unchanged.
steps: Upload your PDF (up to 30 MB).

Press Convert & download and compare the sizes shown.

faqs.q: Which compression level should I use?
faqs.a: Start with Balanced. If the file is still too large, try Maximum, which lowers image quality more. Light keeps the most detail.

faqs.q: Will compression reduce image quality?
faqs.a: Yes, images are recompressed and some are scaled down. Higher levels reduce quality more. Text is not affected.

faqs.q: Why did my file not get smaller?
faqs.a: Text-only or already optimised PDFs have little left to compress. In that case the original file is returned.

steps: Upload your scanned PDF (up to 30 MB).

faqs.q: How many pages are processed?

faqs.q: Where is my file processed?
faqs.a: The pages are sent as images to Google Cloud Vision for text recognition, then the result is returned to you. Files are not kept on our server.

title: Compress PDF for Email
meta_title: Compress PDF for Email Attachments | EasyPDFTools
meta_description: Make a PDF smaller so it fits email attachment limits. Choose a compression level. Files are processed temporarily and not kept. Results depend on the file.
intro: Email providers limit the size of attachments, commonly to around 20-25 MB, and many company mail servers set the limit lower. A PDF with photos or scanned pages can easily go over that limit.

This tool recompresses the images in your PDF and shows you the size before and after. Your file is processed temporarily on our server and is not kept. If the PDF is mostly text, it may not get much smaller.
steps: Upload the PDF you want to send (up to 30 MB).
Choose Balanced first. If it is still too big, try Maximum.
Download the smaller file and attach it to your email.

faqs.q: What is the usual email attachment limit?
faqs.a: It varies by provider and by company. Many allow about 20-25 MB, and some allow less, so check the limit of your own email service.

faqs.q: It is still too large. What now?
faqs.a: Try the Maximum level. You can also use Split PDF to send the document in parts, or share a download link instead of an attachment.

faqs.q: Will the text stay sharp?
faqs.a: Yes. Compression affects the images inside the PDF, not the text.

title: Compress PDF Under 100KB
meta_title: Compress PDF Towards 100KB - Smaller PDF Online | EasyPDFTools
meta_description: Shrink a PDF as far as possible for strict upload limits. Free and no signup. There is no guarantee of reaching 100KB, especially for image-heavy files.
intro: Some government, university and job portals only accept PDF files of about 100 KB or less. This tool can help by recompressing the images in your PDF and scaling down very large ones at its Maximum level.

It cannot promise an exact size. A text-based PDF may already be small, while a scan or a photo-heavy PDF may stay above 100 KB even at the strongest setting. The tool shows the size before and after so you can see the result.
steps: Upload your PDF (up to 30 MB).
Choose the Maximum compression level.
Download the result and check its size against the portal's limit.

faqs.q: Will my PDF reach 100KB?
faqs.a: Not always. Simple documents often shrink a lot, but scans and photo-heavy PDFs may stay larger. If that happens, try scanning at a lower resolution or splitting the document.

faqs.q: How much quality will I lose?
faqs.a: Maximum compression lowers image quality noticeably. Text stays readable, but photos and scanned pages can look softer.

faqs.q: What if the file does not get smaller?
faqs.a: If the result would not be smaller, you receive the original file unchanged, and the page tells you so.

meta_description: Draw your signature and place it on a non-disclosure agreement PDF, right in your browser. The file is not uploaded. Image stamp, not a certified signature.
intro: Need to return a signed non-disclosure agreement quickly? Open the PDF here, draw your signature with a mouse or finger, and click where it belongs. You can then download the signed copy without printing or scanning.

Signing runs in your browser, so your agreement is not uploaded to our server. The result is an image stamp of your signature, not a certified digital signature, so confirm that the other party accepts this kind of signature.
steps: Open your NDA PDF in the signer (up to 30 MB).
Draw your signature, or upload an image of it.
Click the signature line to place it, then download the signed PDF.

faqs.q: Is my NDA uploaded anywhere?
faqs.a: No. Signing happens in your browser and the document stays on your device.

faqs.q: Will this signature be accepted?
faqs.a: It depends on the other party and on local rules. This tool adds an image stamp, not a certified digital signature, so ask the other party if it is acceptable.

faqs.q: Can I add my signature on several pages?
faqs.a: Yes. Tick All pages before clicking to place it at the same spot on every page, or click on each page separately.

title: Sign Lease Agreement PDF
meta_title: Sign a Lease or Rental Agreement PDF Online | EasyPDFTools
meta_description: Sign a lease or rental agreement PDF from your phone or computer by drawing your signature. Runs in your browser; image stamp, not a certified signature.
intro: If your landlord or tenant sent you a lease as a PDF, you can sign it here without printing. Draw your signature with your finger or mouse, place it on the signature line, and download the signed copy.

Signing runs in your browser, so the agreement is not uploaded to our server. The signature is an image stamp, not a certified digital signature. Rules about electronic signatures differ by country and by document, so check what your landlord or agency requires.
steps: Open your lease PDF in the signer (up to 30 MB).
Draw your signature on the pad, or upload an image of it.
Click the signature line, then download the signed PDF.

faqs.q: Can I sign on my phone?
faqs.a: Yes. The signature pad works with touch screens, so you can draw with your finger.

faqs.q: Is my lease uploaded?
faqs.a: No. Signing runs in your browser and the file stays on your device.

faqs.q: Does a lease need more than my signature?
faqs.a: Some leases need initials on several pages. Tick All pages to stamp the same mark on every page, and check any local requirements with your landlord or agency.
